bio: The Fitzwilliam hotel is the perfect place to indulge in a fancy and luxurious Afternoon Tea in the heart of Belfast. This historic establishment embodies the essence of Belfast’s city and culture with its eloquent architecture and grand spacious interior, it exudes the fusion of the past and present that Belfast has to offer.  The Afternoon Tea at The Fitzwilliam Hotel is served in the Hotels adjacent restaurant and is furnished with beautiful antique tables and sleek seating that epitomises the city's decorated history. This ensures for an original Belfast experience.  The Hotels focus on luxury dining is reflected through the content and design of its Afternoon Tea menu. The presentation is at the up most importance along with the produce used to create the selection of finger sandwiches, scones and homemade cakes.  The hotel is positioned right in the centre of Belfast and is surrounded by many shops and key sites such as the Belfast City Hall and titanic memorial garden which are both a short walk away.  The Fitzwilliam Hotel is a two-minute walk away from the Belfast Central Station and makes it easy to visit along with the other sites.  The Fitzwilliam Hotel also serves Children’s Afternoon Tea from 20.00 per child.
